title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll

rights: Project Gutenberg lists this text as public domain in the United States. The included source file retains its terms. Check local copyright law before reuse.
paragraph_selection: All non-heading paragraphs with at least 45 UTF-8 bytes and eight whitespace-delimited words from the declared chapters; exact-text duplicates removed before tokenization.
paragraph_normalization: Before length filtering, deduplication, tokenization, packing, and byte-denominator measurement, collapse each paragraph's whitespace runs to one ASCII space and trim leading and trailing whitespace. Byte denominators count UTF-8 bytes of these normalized paragraph strings, not byte spans in the original Gutenberg file.
tokenizer_fit: Train paragraphs from chapters I-IV only.
rights_note: The source is listed as public domain in the United States. Local law can differ; the source file retains the Project Gutenberg terms.
limitations: One public-domain English novel; validation/test chapters share author, characters, setting and style with training.
